papers.name: Real-Time State-Space Parameterization and Lock-Free Semantic Analysis in Digital Equalization
papers.description: Production-grade parametric EQ architecture: Simper SVF topology, lock-free SPSC triple-buffering, variable-cadence coefficient engine (80% CPU savings), deterministic resonance detection (100% precision/recall). 10 sections, 8 references, measured on i7-3720QM.

papers.name: FreeEQ8 Technical Architecture (dev.to)
papers.description: Published technical deep-dive covering SVF vs RBJ cramping, SPSC concurrency, variable-cadence Dynamic EQ, and allocation-free semantic resonance detection.

papers.name: Studio Violin: Helmholtz Bowed String, H2 Correction, Stradivari Body EQ, and Sympathetic Resonance
papers.description: Published technical article on the Instrudio Studio Violin model covering Helmholtz bowed-string behavior, H2 correction, Stradivari-style body EQ, and sympathetic resonance design.

papers.name: ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder and the Future Economics of Real AI
papers.description: Published article on ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder as a governed local AI build-and-memory system — evidence-preserving model promotion, rollback-safe training, and the missing economic layer in current AI. Compares the ARC approach to FFmpeg-style infrastructure longevity.

papers.name: FreeEQ8 Current Status: Open-Source Parametric EQ, Rekkerd Coverage, and the Road to Smart EQ
papers.description: Published milestone article covering FreeEQ8's Rekkerd.org press coverage, current feature set, Smart EQ layer roadmap (explainable deterministic mix-assist), and Match EQ direction.

papers.name: Made This for Developers & Producers Alike
papers.description: Published ecosystem overview for developers and producers — links plugin ecosystem, free lists and sample packs, press coverage from Rekkerd.org and AudioApp.cn, and the promotional group partnership.

papers.name: Proto-Synth Grid Engine: Building a Math-First 2D World Runtime That Feels 3D
papers.description: Published technical article on Proto-Synth Grid Engine — a deterministic 2D world runtime with blueprint-driven geometry, ARC-Core event discipline, Neural-Synth and Voxel Directory views, and cube-grid projection for 3D-feeling spatial simulation.

papers.name: Therum: A Serum-2-Quality Hybrid Synthesizer in Framework-Free C++
papers.description: Specification paper for Therum, a Serum-2-quality hybrid synthesizer on a framework-free C++ DSP core (iPlug2). Wavetable engine band-limited by construction, filter decramping specified as a tested hypothesis (the FreeEQ8 paper proved the SVF does not decramp), modulation and FX architecture, and the measurement plan that proves Serum 2 quality or better.

papers.name: DAFx26 Paper: Simper SVF Topology and EQ Frequency Cramping (dev.to)
papers.description: DAFx26 Demo Track announcement for the FreeEQ8 paper: Simper SVF topology, SPSC concurrency, and variable-cadence Dynamic EQ. The article's title predates the paper's withdrawal of the decramping claim - the SVF does not decramp, both topologies measure identical, and a -3.383 dB cramping error remains at the geometric-mean frequency; real decramping is future work.
